title: Laboratory fortress_wait arguments
description: One existing tool supports ordinary duration-based waiting, one exact original plan, one condition watch, or an explicit set of retained laboratory watches. Current ownership, grants, complete source bounds and atomic complete response publication remain binding.

session_id.description: Optional wire selector resolved by the existing laboratory session resolver; supply the canonical owning session identifier returned by fortress_open_session.

max_game_ticks.description: Total time cap. Omitted/null means zero. Positive ticks require ControlClock. The world remains paused unless a separately authorized operation unpauses it.

plan_digest.description: One exact session-owned original committed plan; mutually exclusive with non-null watch_id or watch_ids.

watch_id.description: One retained laboratory watch handle. Samples its immutable original condition at bounded published frontiers. Mutually exclusive with non-null plan_digest or watch_ids.

watch_ids.description: One explicit set of one to eight unique owned laboratory watch handles. Every published frontier samples the exact set atomically, respecting each unfinished member's cadence and deadline. Mutually exclusive with non-null plan_digest or watch_id.

watch_policy.description: Group policy for watch_ids only. Omitted/null means all_satisfied. Attention takes precedence over group success. Policies aggregate retained outcomes, including historical terminals, without claiming current simultaneous truth.
